name: Barbell Suitcase Deadlift
steps: Stand alongside the bar, hinge and bend your knees to take a centered grip with the near hand.
Brace and extend your hips and knees to stand with the bar at your side.
Hinge and bend your legs to set the bar down evenly.
Switch sides after finishing this side.
tips: Keep your shoulders and hips level rather than leaning sideways as the bar leaves the floor.
Grip the exact center of the bar so neither end tilts forward or back.
